findings.label: Stuck guard on no-op seek
findings.detail: If a programmatic currentTime write ever targets the current time, the browser may not fire onSeeked and skippingRef stays true, suppressing auto-skip until the next real seek. Guarded in practice by the nextStart > t + 1s threshold, so a real seek always occurs. Non-blocking; noted for future edits.

findings.label: seekVideo bypasses the self-seek guard
findings.detail: Row click / Prev-Next / deep-link (seekVideo) write currentTime without setting skippingRef, so they are handled as manual seeks that resync to nearest. This is the intended behavior; documented so a future change does not wrap seekVideo in the guard and break manual-seek resync.
